altTitles.ja: あなたの裏切りに感謝します

description.en:
“In the house of Count Lakers, it seems that you possess the most exceptional superpower. Perhaps that is the reason why you must die…”

The confession she had heard from her husband at the moment of her death was shocking. Irina, who miraculously returned from death, decides to find a way to escape from her family’s clutches and steal a night with Duke Ian Lancaster…

---
Irina Lakers seem to have the picture-perfect life: wealth, a loving husband, and a family that cares for her. Just when she thought life couldn't get any better, her sweet and loving husband turned out to be the one who had been poisoning her for the past three years. What's worst is that the hidden culprit behind her death is actually...her dad! But when Irina finds herself back in time before she gets killed off, she vows to change her destiny and seeks to change her destined path by stealing lan Lancaster's night...
description.fr: Irina Lakers a tout pour être heureuse: Un mari aimant, une famille attentionnée et beaucoup d’argent. Mais sa vie bascule quand son époux lui révèle la vérité: Il l’empoisonne à petit feu depuis plus de trois ans et elle va bientôt mourir. Sur son lit de mort, Irina apprend que le commanditaire n’était autre que son père. Bouleversée et trahie, elle remonte le temps quelques années plus tôt, bien décidée à changer le cours de son destin!
description.ja:
「レイカーズ伯爵家の中で最も優れた異能力を持っているのは君らしいよ。
もしかしたらそれが君が死ななければならない理由なのかも···」

死の瞬間、夫から聞いた告白は衝撃的だった。

奇跡的に死から帰ってきたイリーナは、自分を取り囲んでいる家族から逃げる方法でイアン・ランカスター公爵の夜を盗むことを決意するが···
description.ko:
“완벽하게 내 밤을 훔쳐냈군.”

===

“레이커스 백작가에서 가장 뛰어난 이능을 가진 사람은 당신이랍니다.
어쩌면 그게 당신이 죽어야 하는 이유인지도 모르겠습니다.”

죽음의 순간, 남편에게 들은 고백은 충격적이었다.

기적적으로 죽음에서 돌아온 이리나는 저를 둘러싸고 있는 가족들에게서
도망치는 방법으로 이안 랭카스터 공작의 밤을 훔치기로 결심하는데…….

“내 밤을 훔친 게 그대이니 그대가 할까?”
“뭘요?”
“사랑 말이야.”

어쩌지?
여우를 피하려다 늑대를 만난 것 같은데.

이 남자 믿어도 괜찮은 걸까?
